jobs.occupation: PhD Position on Privacy and Security of AI-as-a-Service Systems (m,f,x) for 3 years with 39,83 hours (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
In order to fill a fixed-term position in full-time (39.83 hours/week = 100%) at the earliest possible date, we are looking for 1

PhD Position on Privacy and Security of AI-as-a-Service Systems (m,f,x) for 3 years with 39,83 hours per week, TV-L E13

The Ruhr area, one of Europe's largest metropolitan regions, provides attractive career opportunities for outstanding scientists and scholars from around the world. In 2021, Ruhr University Bochum, TU Dortmund University, and the University of Duisburg-Essen established the Research Alliance Ruhr to consolidate their pioneering international research on humanity's most pressing challenges. This alliance encompasses four research centers and a college, marking a new chapter in our enduring collaboration as the University Alliance Ruhr (UA Ruhr), a vibrant community of 14,000 researchers and 120,000 students located in the heart of Germany. Join us and contribute to cutting-edge research at RC Trust, where innovation meets real-world impact. As part of the Research Alliance Ruhr, the Research Center for Trustworthy Data Science and Security unites the expertise of its member universities to bridge the gaps between Psychology & Social Sciences, Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, Data Science & Statistical Learning, and Cybersecurity & Privacy. The Research Alliance Ruhr, a collaborative initiative by the three major universities in the Ruhr area, was established through the Ruhr Conference. It encompasses four research centers: "One Health Ruhr," "Chemical Sciences and Sustainability," "Trustworthy Data Science and Security," and "Future Energy Materials and Systems." Additionally, it includes a "College for Social Sciences and Humanities." The Research Alliance Ruhr is appointing up to 50 research professors and offers numerous positions for research assistants. Join us in creating innovations for the future within Europe's most densely populated yet greenest university landscape, where a diverse range of scientific and industrial partners are readily accessible. The position is embedded in the collaborative research project DAISY – Data Protection and Employee Interests in AI-as-a-Service Systems, funded by the German Federal Ministry of Research, Technology and Space (BMFTR) under the program "Plattform Privatheit – IT Security Protects Privacy and Supports Democracy." Organizations increasingly purchase AI capabilities as ready-made cloud services (AI-as-a-Service, AIaaS) without any insight into the underlying architectures, data flows, or security mechanisms. DAISY investigates how such systems can be adopted in a privacy-compliant and employee-centered way, combining computer science, psychology, and organizational science. Together with the University of Duisburg-Essen, Witten/Herdecke University, and the Bochum Economic Development Agency as application partner, the consortium examines the mental models that decision-makers and employees hold of AIaaS, contrasts them with the actual technical properties of these systems, and derives measures to bring the two into alignment.

This position covers the technical perspective of the project at Ruhr University Bochum: characterizing real-world AIaaS systems empirically, condensing their privacy- and security-relevant properties into risk profiles, and developing and evaluating privacy-compliant AIaaS configurations built from open-source components. The work follows a human-centered perspective on security and privacy, combining technical analysis with empirical research on the people who use these systems. The position is designed to lead to a doctorate and is embedded in the graduate structures of RC Trust. This is an on-site position in Bochum; regular presence at the university is expected. Remote work is possible on individual days by arrangement, but the position cannot be carried out fully remotely.

Scope: full-time
Duration: fixed-term, 36 Monate
Start: at the earliest possible date
Apply by:  2026-10-05

Your tasks:

Within the project, you will shape your own research agenda around the following tasks:

- Survey the technical state of the art on privacy and security architectures of AIaaS in a systematic literature review
- Empirically characterize commercially available AIaaS systems with respect to their privacy- and security-relevant properties, and systematize the findings into risk profiles
- Design, implement, and iteratively refine privacy-compliant AIaaS configurations from open-source components, and test them on real use cases with our application partner
- Evaluate these configurations with respect to security, performance, and scalability
- Collaborate closely with partners from psychology, organizational science, and practice, and make technical findings accessible to non-expert audiences
- Publish research results at leading international venues in security, privacy, and human-centered security

Your profile:

- Master's degree in computer science, IT security, or a closely related technical field (or shortly before completion)
- Solid programming skills (e.g., Python) and practical experience with web APIs and cloud services
- Hands-on experience with large language models — for instance, self-hosting open-weight models, building LLM-based pipelines, or working with commercial provider APIs
- First research experience in security and privacy
- Demonstrable interest in interdisciplinary research, and in working with companies as practice partners
- High proficiency in English, both written and spoken, for scientific publications and presentations
- Working proficiency in German (at least B2, or willingness to reach this level early in the project): the project is carried out with German partner organizations and reporting to the funding agency is in German

jobs.occupation: Research Associate / PhD Studend / PostDoc (m/f/x) Adaptive multiplane light conversion (Physiker/in)
jobs.description:
TUD Dresden University of Technology, as a University of Excellence, is one of the leading and most dynamic research institutions in the country. Accordingly, we welcome all applicants who would like to commit themselves, their achievements and productivity to the success of the whole institution.

At the Faculty of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Institute of Circuits and Systems, the Chair of Measurement and Sensor System Technique offers a position as

Research Associate / PhD Studend / PostDoc (m/f/x)

Adaptive multiplane light conversion

(subject to personal qualification, employees are remunerated according to salary group E 13 TV-L)

within the Reinhart-Koselleck-project starting as soon as possible. The position is limited to 3 years. The period of employment is governed by the Fixed Term Research Contracts Act (Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz - WissZeitVG). The position comprises up to 100% of the fulltime weekly hours. Balancing family and career are an important issue. The position is generally suitable for candidates seeking part-time employment. Please indicate your request in your application. The position offers the chance to obtain further academic qualification (usually PhD / habilitation thesis).

Tasks:

The focus is on research into innovative concepts for closed-loop control with multiplane light conversion using spatial light modulators, which enable multiplexing via the spatial degrees of freedom towards aberration correction in multimode fibers. For this purpose, spatial modulation techniques for the generation of structured light are investigated for classical laser waves and entangled photons. Your activities include the realization of an adaptive multiplane light conversion system, the implementation of experiments toward the transfer of the unique advantages to real-world applications and the scientific publication of the results. Your responsibilities include:

- characterization of the transmission properties of multimode optical fibers using physics-informed deep learning
- experimental and simulation-based investigations of optical diffractive neural networks
- development and implementation of novel diffractive networks for mode, wavelength, and polarization multiplexing in multimode optical fibers
- publication of research results in international scientific journals, filing of patents, and presentation of conference contributions (the research group has delivered more than 100 invited talks on all continents in recent years)
- the position can be flexibly tailored to focus on experimental laboratory work or simulation-based studies

Requirements: 

- above-average university degree in in the subject physics, computer science, information systems technique, electrical engineering, mechatronics, or related areas
- ability and willingness to work independently and conceptually in a team, in a goal-oriented manner, with a high level of commitment 
- excellent written and spoken German and English skills
- interest in practice-oriented, interdisciplinary collaboration with international cooperation partners from research and industry
- knowledge of software development, deep learning, computational imaging, Fourier optics
- previous knowledge of quantum optics, waveguide optics, multiplane light conversion, MATLAB or Python is advantageous

We offer: 

- a diverse, cutting-edge and challenging research position with your own externally funded research project, dedicated funding and opportunities to shape and develop your research 
- an interdisciplinary research group whose pioneering paradigm shifts have been recognized with prestigious awards (more than 100 awards in total) 
- state-of-the-art laboratories and research facilities 
- opportunities to publish in high-quality scientific journals and attend international conferences for scientific exchange 
- excellent connections with research and industry partners 
- flexible working hours 
- 30 days of annual leave (based on a five-day working week) 
- participation in the supplementary public-sector pension scheme through VBL

TUD strives to employ more women in academia and research. We therefore expressly encourage women to apply. The university is a family-friendly university. We welcome applications from candidates with disabilities. If multiple candidates prove to be equally qualified, those with disabilities or with equivalent status pursuant to the German Social Code IX (SGB IX) will receive priority for employment.

Application:

Please submit your detailed application with the usual documents by September 23, 2026 (stamped arrival date of the university central mail service or the time stamp on the email server of TUD applies), by sending it as a single pdf file to grp-application-mst@msx.tu-dresden.de (https://mailto:grp-application-mst@msx.tu-dresden.de)  (Please note: We are currently not able to receive electronically signed and encrypted data) or to:

TU Dresden, Chair of Measurement and Sensor System Technique, Prof. Juergen Czarske, Helmholtzstr. 10, 01069 Dresden, Germany.

Please submit copies only, as your application will not be returned to you. Expenses incurred in attending interviews cannot be reimbursed.

TUD is a founding partner in the DRESDEN-concept alliance.

https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis (https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis) .

jobs.description:
About us Die European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH
ist das Joint Venture von TSMC, Bosch, Infineon und NXP. Erstmals
errichtet der weltweite Technologieführer TSMC eine Halbleiterfabrik
im Herzen Europas, die kleinste Fertigungstechnologien für
Halbleiterprodukte der nächsten Generation bietet. ESMC steht für
das gemeinsame Engagement zur Stärkung des europäischen
Halbleiter-Ökosystems. Für unsere zukünftige Fab in Dresden suchen
wir eine/n hochmotivierte/n und engagierte/n: International Logistics
Specialist (Import/Export) (m/f/d) At ESMC, we are building a
state-of-the-art semiconductor fab in Dresden. As part of our
international Supply Chain organization, you will play a key role in
establishing efficient global logistics processes that ensure the
reliable movement of materials, equipment and goods across
international borders. This position offers the opportunity to shape
logistics processes from the ground up in an international greenfield
environment while working closely with colleagues, logistics providers
and customs authorities around the world. Tasks Manage international
import and export shipments for the Dresden fab and related locations.
Coordinate daily logistics operations together with freight forwarders
and logistics service providers. Support customs clearance activities
and ensure compliant import and export processes. Review
logistics-related invoices and payment processes within SAP. Monitor
logistics service providers against agreed KPIs and support continuous
performance improvements. Collaborate closely with internal
departments, suppliers, customs authorities and international
logistics partners. Support the implementation and harmonization of
global logistics processes and systems. Identify opportunities to
improve logistics, customs and global trade processes in a rapidly
growing manufacturing environment. Contribute to establishing scalable
logistics structures within our greenfield project. Profile Required:
Bachelor’s or Master´s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain
Management, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering or a
comparable qualification. Several years of professional experience
(approximately 7+ years) in international logistics, import/export,
customs or global trade. Strong knowledge of customs regulations and
international import/export processes. Practical experience
coordinating international shipments. Experience working with customs
brokers, freight forwarders and logistics providers. Strong
communication skills and experience working with international
stakeholders. Fluent German and good English skills. Nice to have:
Experience within semiconductor, electronics, automotive or other
manufacturing industries. Experience with SAP, ideally SAP S/4HANA.
Knowledge of export control regulations. Mandarin language skills. We
offer Help build a completely new semiconductor manufacturing site in
Europe. Work in a highly international environment with colleagues
across Europe, Taiwan and the US. Shape logistics processes instead of
maintaining existing structures. Participate in global projects and
cross-functional collaboration. International onboarding including
4–6 weeks of training in Taiwan and Arizona. Additional contact
details Please apply with your English resume. The ESMC recruiting
team will get in touch with you if your candidacy fits the hiring
criteria.

jobs.occupation: Equipment Engineer (m/f/d) - Start Date: 1 October 2026 (Ingenieur/in - Maschinenbau)
jobs.description:
About us European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) is a
joint venture between four technology leaders, TSMC, Bosch, Infineon
and NXP, to establish a state-of-the-art semiconductor fab in the
heart of Europe. ESMC represents our shared commitment to
strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. Für unsere
zukünftige Fab in Dresden suchen wir eine/n hochmotivierte/n und
engagierte/n: Equipment Engineer (m/f/d) – Start Date: 1 October
2026 At ESMC, the Equipment Engineer supports the installation,
maintenance, troubleshooting, and optimization of advanced
semiconductor manufacturing equipment in a cleanroom environment. As
part of a high-volume 24/7 fab operation, the role focuses on ensuring
tool performance, improving uptime, reducing defects, and supporting
stable production. The position requires openness to scheduled and
occasional shift work, on call duty, includes an initial induction and
training period in Dresden of one month, followed by one year of
on-the-job training in Taiwan. If you are interested in advancing your
career in semiconductor manufacturing, learning from one of the
world’s leading semiconductor companies, and joining an
international and diverse team on a unique learning journey, apply now
with your English CV. Tasks 1. Maintain equipment performance in a
cleanroom environment to support stable, high-quality production. 2.
Handle on-duty tasks and perform fundamental alarm troubleshooting. 3.
Install and qualify new tool sets according to project plans and
schedules. 4. Identify root causes and solve critical equipment
issues. 5. Improve tool uptime and availability while driving defect
reduction. 6. Identify and pursue opportunities for hardware
capability enhancement. 7. Build defense and monitoring systems to
prevent equipment failures and performance loss. 8. Manage vendor
relationships and act as module liaison with facilities, vendors, and
manufacturing shift personnel. 9. Support scheduled night shifts,
evening shifts, weekend work, on-duty assignments, and on-call duties
as required in a 24/7 high-volume manufacturing environment. Profile

1. Legally eligible to work in Germany. 2. Available for approximately
one year of on-the-job training in Taiwan. 3. Open for scheduled and
occasional shift work, on call duty. 4. Degree in electronics,
electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, mechanics,
mechatronics, material engineering, or an equivalent field. 5.
Practical experience in a mechanical or equipment-related field. 6.
Understanding of technical documentation and schematics. 7. Knowledge
of semiconductor manufacturing is a plus. 8. Fluent in English with
good command of German. 9. Hands-on working attitude with an open
mindset. 10. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. 11. Able
to perform physical work on tools in a cleanroom environment.
Important Candidate Information: Start Date: This role is planned to
commence on October 1, 2026, in Dresden. Depending on your needs and
timeline preferences, January 1, 2027, can be considered as an
alternative start date. Onboarding and International Training: The
first month of your employment will be spent in Dresden. Following
this initial onboarding, training, and integration with your new team
members, you will travel to Taiwan for a one-year on-the-job training
and knowledge transfer program. Your training in Taiwan will involve
close collaboration with experienced TSMC engineering teams. You may
also receive additional training and support at TSMC’s
state-of-the-art Newcomer Training Center in Taichung. Training
Logistics: For employees requiring accommodation during the first
month in Dresden, and who reside more than 90 minutes away, ESMC will
organize appropriate temporary lodging. This provision does not apply
to employees who establish a residential address in Dresden (e.g., to
expedite work permit procedures away from their original place of
residence) or who terminate a personal lease contract in Dresden prior
to their planned departure to Taiwan. Furthermore, ESMC will organize
and provide air and ground transportation from Dresden to Taichung
(Taiwan) and back at the conclusion of the training. Accommodation in
Taiwan will be provided in one of TSMC’s modern and comfortable
company dormitories. Role Requirements and Expectations: This is a
unique opportunity to gain exposure to TSMC’s world-leading advanced
manufacturing practices and actively contribute to building ESMC from
the ground up. As a start-up organization, ESMC offers the opportunity
to play an active role in shaping the company’s culture, future
organization and ways of working. Candidates should be comfortable in
a dynamic environment where certain operational details such as
processes, documentation, shift structures, will continue to evolve
during the ramp-up phase. This role is ideal for individuals with a
strong growth mindset, a positive attitude, and a long-term
perspective. We offer Jede Reise beginnt mit dem ersten Schritt. Der
Einstieg bei ESMC zu diesem frühen Zeitpunkt bietet Ihnen die
einzigartige Gelegenheit, aktiv die Zukunft des Werks in Dresden
mitzugestalten, Ihre Karriere voranzutreiben und Ihr wahres Potenzial

gleichzeitig Zugang zur Erfahrung, zum Talent und zu den Ressourcen
des größten und fortschrittlichsten Halbleiterherstellers der Welt,
TSMC, haben. Sie haben reichlich Gelegenheit, mehr über die

fortgeschrittene Themen im Zusammenhang mit Anlagen weltweit zu
lernen, sowohl in Taiwan als auch an anderen Standorten auf der

promising future. The TALKE Group is one of the leading specialist

jobs.occupation: Engineer - Engineering Ambulatory CTO SaaS, Framework (m/f/d) (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
As the leading company in the field of software solutions for healthcare, we operate in 19 countries and employ over 9,000 dedicated staff members. You will work in a dynamic and innovative environment full of opportunities. With your commitment and passion, you have the chance to make a sustainable difference.

CGM Leverages AI: We’re looking for people who feel the power of AI in the e-health environment, who want to help shape change, and who are driven by a curious passion to see how technology can make healthcare smarter, simpler, and better.

Together, we are shaping the healthcare system of the future. Become part of our mission and make a difference - for a world where knowledge saves lives!

Are you passionate about groundbreaking products? Do you have the talent to turn ideas into real, valuable solutions-while always keeping the bigger picture in mind? Then we’d love to meet you!

You take end-to-end accountability for a large, distributed engineering organization that owns our ambulatory SaaS solutions and the shared framework modules used across all AIS DE products.

You co-define and drive the strategic product-technology roadmap for our cloud-based ambulatory portfolio in close collaboration with the executive leadership team.

You ensure that healthcare regulatory requirements-including medical device regulations, audits, and compliance-are rigorously embedded into product development, delivery, and operations.

You lead senior leaders and cross-functional teams, continuously increasing scalability, quality, AI maturity, and innovation velocity across products and platforms.

You represent the domain internally and externally, build strong executive-level stakeholder relationships, and position CGM as a leading SaaS provider in the Health-IT market.

Long-standing leadership experience at Director / VP / CTO level in SaaS product development, ideally with responsibility for large, distributed engineering organizations and complex product portfolios.

Exceptional academic background with a completed university degree and excellent grades, preferably in computer science, medical informatics, engineering, or a comparable technical field.

Deep expertise in cloud architectures and SaaS platforms, including modern DevOps practices and reliability engineering; hands-on experience with healthcare regulations (medical devices, audits, certifications) is a strong advantage.

Proven track record of driving AI adoption in engineering organizations, ideally with first-hand familiarity of Claude Code or comparable agentic coding tools (agents, skills, and workflows) and experience shaping AI pipelines, harnesses, and context engineering at organizational scale.

Excellent English and very good German, a strategic and entrepreneurial mindset, strong execution focus, outstanding leadership and communication skills, and the ability to guide complex organizations through transformation while staying clearly aligned with our healthcare purpose.

Mobile work: Work flexibly on the move two days a week and on site three days a week.

Attractive locations: In addition to fully equipped workplaces, regular events such as summer parties and Christmas parties await you at our locations.

Development: Our in-house academy and our portfolio of external cooperation partners will support you in your further development.

Health: Health is a valuable asset for us. Our in-house canteen offers a selection of tasty and healthy dishes every day, and we welcome you to our fully equipped fitness center for weekly courses (online & offline).

More is always possible: The kindergarten on our CGM campus in Koblenz helps our employees to organize their working day even more flexibly. We also offer corporate benefits, the option of a job bike, a company pension scheme, and much more.

Diversity is part of CGM! We look forward to receiving your application regardles...

jobs.occupation: Research Associate (m/w/d) (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description:
Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz (JGU) is one of the largest universities in Germany. Thanks to its location in the Rhine-Main science region, the university can unfold to its full potential and showcase its innovative power and dynamism. Its status as a comprehensive university allows for multidisciplinary learning and teaching and has great potential for internationally renowned, interdisciplinary research. Almost all of its institutes are located on a single campus close to the Mainz city center - creating a lively academic culture for researchers, teaching staff, and students from every continent.
PhD student: Plant RNA Biology
The Wachter group at the Institute for Molecular Physiology (Faculty 10: Biology of Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz) investigates the molecular mechanisms and biological functions of alternative RNA splicing in plants. Our recent work identified a structured mRNA element that regulates specific DEAD-box helicase genes and revealed their critical role in controlling alternative splicing. Intriguingly, these functions appear to be linked to unique C-terminal features of the respective helicases. As a member of an interdisciplinary and international research team, you will investigate the molecular mechanisms underlying the splicing-regulatory activity of these DEAD-box helicases, with a particular focus on the functional relevance of RGG motifs, subcellular localisation, and their potential involvement in phase separation. In collaboration with the Weinberg group (University Halle-Wittenberg), you will also explore how helicase targeting of pre-mRNA structural elements may intersect with the binding of splicing regulators to determine splice site choice. Your research will employ a multidisciplinary approach that integrates molecular biology, RNA biochemistry, cell biology, and plant physiology, with Arabidopsis thaliana as the primary model system. You will benefit from extensive expertise, various core facilities, and a completely new research infrastructure. The PhD project is funded by the DFG and can be integrated in the international PhD programme (IPP) in Mainz.
Applying state-of-the-art techniques for gene-specific and genome-wide analyses of RNA biology, including transcriptome-wide profiling of alternative splicing and mapping of protein-RNA interactions
Employing in vitro and in vivo experimental systems to address different levels of complexity and advance our understanding of the biological functions
Contributing to teaching activities for Bachelor’s and Master’s students within our group
Assisting with organizational and administrative tasks
Presenting your research findings in oral and written form, including conference contributions, reports, and manuscripts

A successfully completed scientific university degree in Biology or in a related field
Practical experience with a spectrum of molecular methods
A background in plant molecular biology and/or RNA biology
Very good English language skills (at least level B2)
A fascination for science, very good communication, and teamwork skills

In addition to the general requirements according to public services law, applicants must meet the recruitment requirements stipulated in § 57 of the Hochschulgesetz of Rhineland-Palatinate.
Secure and transparent remuneration in accordance with the collective agreement of the federal states as well as additional benefits such as an annual special payment and company pension scheme
Discounted Deutschlandticket
Flexible working hours, 30 days' vacation and fair rules for balancing work and family life
Together, we are advancing science and society on this lively and dynamic campus
A wide range of offers for the development of your talents and perspectives
Opportunity to participate in general university sports programs

jobs.description:
Glycothera is a specialized CDMO supporting biologics development across cell line development, process development, analytics, and GMP-aligned testing. Operating from integrated sites in Julich and Hanover, Germany, the company works within a unified scientific and quality framework that enables reliable, regulatory-ready CMC execution. With nearly three decades of development experience and long-standing contributions to biologics supported by EMA and FDA approvals, Glycothera partners with biotech and pharmaceutical companies to advance development programs with scientific depth, precision, and consistency.

Scientist (m/f/d) Functional Assay
(full-time, permanent)

For our site in Jülich (Germany) we are looking for a highly motivated Bench Scientist to join our Functional Assay team. The main area of responsibility will be the development and execution of cell-based functional assays. In addition, the successful candidate will have the opportunity to work closely with the binding group to conduct Biacore/SPR assays.
Perform, evaluate and document experiments for method development of functional assays, including cell-based assays (e.g. potency, CDC, ADCC, ADCP, apoptosis assay, proliferation assay) and binding assays (e.g. Biacore/SPR) according to ICH guidelines.
Handle cell lines and primary cells (e.g. isolation, freezing, thawing, propagation, testing).
Analyze samples to support the development of therapeutic candidates across various departments/process steps.
Perform, evaluate and document functional assays for analytical similarity and comparability studies.
Draft regulatory documents, including SOPs, R&D-Procedures and development reports.
Support method validation and method transfer activities.
Take care of laboratory equipment (e.g., perform instrument maintenance and qualification) and support laboratory management tasks.
The role will be primarily lab-based.

B.Sc. in relevant scientific discipline (life sciences such as biology, biomedical sciences, biochemistry, biotechnology, etc.) with minimum 3-5 years of relevant work experience, or M.Sc. with 1-2 years of relevant work experience.
Experience working with mammalian cell lines under aseptic conditions, including culture initiation, propagation and cryopreservation is a must. Separation and purification of primary human cells is a plus.
Experience with potency and bioassay development (e.g., CDC, ADCC, proliferation, apoptosis) for monoclonal antibody analysis is required. Experience with other modalities is a plus.
Experience with relevant analytical methods (e.g., ELISA formats, Flow Cytometry) is required.
Experience with biochemical and biophysical methods for binding characterization (e.g., Biacore/SPR) is advantageous.
Attention to detail and precise work habits.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Proficient in using a PC and common Microsoft packages. Experience with specific laboratory instrumentation (e.g., Biacore T200 and 8K, MSD, Flow cytometer, microplate reader) and analysis software (e.g., SoftMax, Methodical Mind, MACSQuantify, Biacore Insight) is a plus.

You are a smart, proactive and solution-driven scientist with a hands-on attitude who is able to independently progress projects, prioritize tasks adequately and work against tight timelines. At the same time, you maintain a high-quality standard in your work, support the team and foster a sense of positivity. If this sounds like you, then join us in shaping what’s next!

Language: English, German is beneficial.

Work Experience: Industrial work experience (biotechnology/biopharma) is highly appreciated. Our Jülich site with currently 40 employees offers an innovative, vibrant and multicultural environment that gives you the chance to bring in all of your competencies, and together with a highly motivated team drive the change and develop personally. We believe in a culture of respect, trust, reliability and positivity.
